Hi Patricia, 
  
 Thank you for your thoughtful email. I appreciate you taking the time to ask for feedback. 
  
 After evaluating both platforms, there were several factors that ultimately led us to choose Overjet. 
  
 The biggest issue we experienced with Pearl was the frequent loss of connectivity with our Eaglesoft software. We also found that the AI did not consistently follow image rotations or mirrored radiographs within Eaglesoft, which created workflow inefficiencies and required additional manual intervention. 
  
 From our evaluation, we also felt that Overjet demonstrated greater diagnostic accuracy, particularly with CBCT integration. We were impressed by the additional functionality it offers beyond AI-assisted radiograph interpretation, including the dashboard that highlights treatment opportunities and potentially undiagnosed conditions, which we believe will provide valuable clinical and operational insights.

Dear  Pearl  Research Team,  
 I hope you are well.  
 I am reaching out to explore a potential research collaboration to clinically validate your AI-based radiographic system for caries detection in primary molars.  
 We are designing a prospective diagnostic accuracy study in which primary molars indicated for extraction (due to physiologic exfoliation, orthodontic reasons, or parental request) will first undergo standardized bitewing radiography. These radiographs will be independently assessed by your AI platform and by blinded, calibrated pediatric dentists.  
 Following extraction, each tooth will undergo high-resolution micro-CT scanning. Micro-CT findings (lesion presence and depth) will serve as the gold standard, allowing direct comparison of:  
  ·           Sensitivity and specificity  
  ·           ROC/AUC performance  
  ·           Lesion depth accuracy  
  ·           Agreement between AI, human examiners, and true 3D structural findings  
 This design provides strong scientific rigor by using a true structural reference standard rather than clinical judgment alone. The study would generate high-quality, publishable evidence specific to pediatric dentition and offer independent validation data supporting clinical and regulatory positioning.  
 We are seeking research access to your AI platform, technical collaboration for standardized analysis, and the opportunity for scientific partnership (including potential co-authorship). Funding support could also be discussed if aligned with your research initiatives.  
 I would welcome the opportunity to briefly discuss whether this aligns with your current research goals.  
 Thank you for your time and consideration.
